summary.en: US futures retreat as geopolitical optimism fades; U.S.-Iran MOU faces implementation skepticism with VP Vance's Switzerland trip cancelled. Tech stocks lead morning losses amid tech-led Friday rally reversal. Oil prices stabilize after Hormuz reopening, but USD strength pressures gold/silver to multi-week lows.
summary.zh: 美股期货因地缘政治乐观情绪消退而回落；美伊备忘录实施引发质疑，副总统万斯取消瑞士访问。科技股领跌早盘市场，延续周五科技主导的反弹势头。油价在霍尔木兹重开后企稳，但美元走强打压金/银跌至数周低位。

title.en: US Stock Futures Retreat After Iran Peace Optimism Fades
title.zh: 美伊和平乐观情绪消退后美股期货回落

impact.en: Markets reverse Friday's tech rally as diplomatic optimism wanes; VP Vance cancelled Switzerland trip on unverified Iranian demands for MoU implementation checks.
impact.zh: 随着外交乐观情绪降温，市场逆转周五科技股涨势；副总统万斯取消瑞士之行，因伊朗未证实要求先检查协议执行情况。

macroRisk.en: Geopolitical risk premium returning; may compress tech valuations, benefit oil producers indirectly via inflation concerns but overall mixed sentiment.
macroRisk.zh: 地缘政治风险溢价回归；可能压缩科技股估值，油价生产商因通胀担忧间接受益但整体情绪分化。

title.en: KOSPI Reverses Record High on Samsung/Hynix Profit-Taking
title.zh: 韩综指在三星/海力士获利了结后从历史高位回落

impact.en: Asian tech leaders sold off after hitting records; SK Hynix fell from early peak, Hyundai Motor on Boston Dynamics stake news.
impact.zh: 亚洲科技龙头触及新高后被抛售；SK 海力士早盘见顶，现代汽车因波士顿动力持股引发波动。

macroRisk.en: Semiconductor sector rotation; Asian supply chain uncertainty dampens sentiment.
macroRisk.zh: 半导体板块轮动；亚洲供应链不确定性压制情绪。

title.en: Gold/Silver Drop Amid Hawkish Fed & Strong Dollar
title.zh: 金/银在鹰派美联储与强势美元下下跌

impact.en: DXY broke 100.55 resistance; gold falls as Fed maintains higher-for-longer rates stance, inflation risk premium still elevated.
impact.zh: 美元指数突破 100.55；美联储维持高利率立场，通胀溢价仍高企打压贵金属。

macroRisk.en: Real yields up; rate-sensitive assets suffer while dollar strengthens on improved US growth data.
macroRisk.zh: 实际收益率上升；利率敏感资产受损，美元因美国增长数据改善走强。

title.en: Oil Price Stabilizes After Hormuz Reopening
title.zh: 霍尔木兹重开后油价企稳

impact.en: 6 oil tankers passed Strait; geopolitical risk premium unwinds but concerns about terms interpretation persist. WTI testing key support at $73.
impact.zh: 6 艘油轮通过海峡；地缘政治风险溢价消退，但双方对协议条款解读分歧持续。WTI 测试关键支撑$73。

macroRisk.en: Lower oil helps inflation but creates sector divergence; energy plays benefit while rate-sensitive tech pressured.
macroRisk.zh: 油价下行助通胀回落但造成板块分化；能源股受益而利率敏感科技股承压。

title.en: AMD Rallies on Data Center Growth Narrative
title.zh: AMD 因数据中心增长叙事大涨

impact.en: 280% YTD gains; AI infrastructure demand remains strong despite broader market correction.
impact.zh: 年内涨幅超 280%；尽管大盘回调，AI 基础设施需求仍强劲。

macroRisk.en: Data center capex cycle continues; competition intensifies but demand structural.
macroRisk.zh: 数据中心资本支出周期持续；竞争加剧但需求结构性增长。

title.zh: 十年美债收益率至 4.45%，美元走强

impact.en: Rates stabilize above 50-day MA; curve inversion deepens as short-term yields hit multi-decade highs.
impact.zh: 利率在 50 日均线上方企稳；收益率曲线倒挂加深，短端收益率创数十年新高。

macroRisk.en: Fed hawkish dot plot; inversion signals recession fears but growth data supports rates.
macroRisk.zh: 美联储鹰派观点；倒挂反映衰退担忧但增长数据支撑高利率。

title.en: European Markets Cautious Ahead of US Open
title.zh: 欧洲市场开盘前保持谨慎

impact.en: Euro Stoxx 50 futures flat; ECB rate hike debate continues amid weak growth outlook.
impact.zh: 欧斯托指数期货持平；增长前景疲软，ECB 加息辩论继续。

macroRisk.en: Euro pressure from USD; ECB policy divergence concerns.
macroRisk.zh: 欧元受美元压力；ECB 政策分化担忧。

ai.en: AI sector showing resilience despite broad market retreat. AMD's data center narrative remains intact, NVDA bond deal provides funding flexibility. Hardware supply chain demand sustained.
ai.zh: 尽管大盘回落，AI 板块表现 resilient。AMD 数据中心叙事完整，NVIDIA 债券交易提供资金灵活性。硬件供应链需求持续。

semiconductor.en: Mixed signals: TSMC strong but Asian semiconductor stocks corrected after record highs. Korean memory sector taking profit; global supply chain diversification ongoing.
semiconductor.zh: 信号分化：台积电强势但亚洲半导体股从历史新高回吐。韩国存储板块获利；全球供应链分散化进行中。

bigTech.en: Magnificent Seven cooling off after Friday's rally; MSFT/AAPL flat in Asia session. Cloud revenue growth expected to remain key driver despite near-term volatility.
bigTech.zh: 七大巨头在周五反弹后降温；微软/苹果亚洲休市。云收入增长仍是关键驱动因素，短期波动不影响长期预期。

energy.en: Oil producers stabilizing after geopolitical event driven surge. XOM/CVX benefit from lower volatility but capex discipline remains crucial amid inflation concerns.
energy.zh: 能源生产商在地缘事件驱动飙升后企稳。油价波动性降低使雪佛龙/埃克森受益，但通胀担忧下资本支出纪律至关重要。

ev.en: EV sector under pressure from Tesla high-beta volatility and broader tech rotation. FSD margin questions emerge; Chinese EV competition continues to impact global auto pricing.
ev.zh: 电动车板块在特斯拉高波动和科技轮动中承压。FSD 利润率问题浮现；中国电动汽车竞争持续影响全球定价。

market.en: Broad index futures cooling; Nasdaq leading decline but not panic. Small caps (Russell) more sensitive to rate environment, showing tech divergence from growth story.
market.zh: 宽基指数期货降温；纳指领跌但未恐慌。小盘股对利率环境更敏感，显示科技板块与成长叙事分化。

preciousMetals.en: Gold/silver under heavy pressure from DXY strength and real yields. Fed hawkish stance limits safe-haven demand despite geopolitical headlines. XAU/USD testing next support zone.
preciousMetals.zh: 金银受美元和实际收益率压制。美联储鹰派立场限制避险需求，尽管地缘新闻仍在。黄金测试下一支撑区。

oil.en: WTI stabilizing around $73 after Hormuz reopening news. Geopolitical risk premium unwinds but implementation concerns persist; OPEC+ production discipline remains key watch.
oil.zh: 油价在霍尔木兹重开后围绕$73 企稳。地缘风险溢价消退但执行担忧仍在；OPEC+ 生产纪律是关键观察点。

futures.en: S&P futures -0.7%, Nasdaq -1.0%, Dow -0.45% in Asia session
futures.zh: 亚洲时段标普期货-0.7%，纳指-1.0%，道指-0.45%

treasury10Y.en: 10Y Treasury yield 4.45%, down 3bps from Friday close
treasury10Y.zh: 十年美债收益率 4.45%（周五收盘下跌 3bp）

dxy.en: Dollar Index above 100.86, broke May resistance levels
dxy.zh: 美元指数高于 100.86，突破五月阻力位

oil.en: WTI testing $73 support; Brent easing below $75 after Hormuz passage confirmed
oil.zh: WTI 测试$73支撑；布伦特在霍尔木兹通航确认后回落至$75下方

keyRisk.en: Iran MoU implementation uncertainty + US Fed hawkish pivot on inflation. Watch for VP Vance trip news or ECB rate debate impact.
keyRisk.zh: 美伊协议实施不确定性+美联储通胀鹰派转向。关注副总统行程新闻或欧央行利率辩论影响。

note.en: Mixed sentiment: tech sector divergence despite growth story, rate sensitivity outweighs earnings optimism. Geopolitical headlines create cross-asset transmission (oil→inflation→rates) dominating over company-level narratives.
note.zh: 情绪分化：尽管成长叙事持续，科技板块出现分歧；利率敏感性盖过盈利乐观。地缘新闻主导跨资产传导（油价→通胀预期→收益率），而非个股叙事。

disclaimer: YUCLAW signals are research classifications, NOT investment recommendations. This brief is for informational purposes only.
